description.short: Answers from your workspace's documents and meetings, with sources.
description.full: Mention @{{BRAND_SHORT}} in a channel or chat to get answers from the linked client workspace's documents and meeting transcripts, with sources. Your organization signs up at {{BRAND_SHORT}} first; when someone adds {{BRAND_SHORT}} to a chat, an admin or the group's leader assigns it to a workspace in the {{BRAND_SHORT}} portal, and leaders can add teammates right from the chat with @{{BRAND_SHORT}} add. After each Teams meeting {{BRAND_SHORT}} writes the notes from the transcript and posts the decisions and action items to the group's notes chat: assign or close action items and save decisions to the group's knowledge right from the card. The {{BRAND_SHORT}} tab (in the app bar, or added to a chat, channel or meeting) shows the group's meetings, notes and open action items. In chats an admin chooses to track, {{BRAND_SHORT}} reads the messages to keep track of decisions and dates, and posts reminders about what's still open.
